remarks: Welcome to waterfront living at its best! This 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and coastal charm located directly on the water with serene marina views. This pristine, move-in ready home features an open-concept main level with bright living space, kitchen, and dining area that flows seamlessly to a private patio overlooking the water-ideal for relaxing or entertaining. The spacious primary bedroom is filled with natural light and features sliding glass doors opening onto a large balcony for morning coffee while taking in the sunrise over the marina and long island sound. The primary bedroom includes a large walk-in closet designed for optimal organization and an updated en-suite bath with glass-enclosed shower. Two additional bedrooms offer large walk-in closets, ensuring spacious accommodations for guests or family. An updated hall bath with tub and shower completes the second floor. The attached one car garage, additional storage room, and attic storage are added bonuses to this unit. Community amenities include a pool and pool house, plus scenic walkways along the water. The private marina has boat slips available for rent. This location offers easy access to parks, train stations, beaches, and vibrant restaurants, bars, and city amenities. This well-maintained home combines modern features in an unbeatable waterfront setting offering indoor-outdoor living at its best.
